finalLetter: Three years ago, I found you.
And every day since, the world has been a little brighter, a little warmer, a little more like home.
We've laughed until it hurt, held each other through storms, and danced in the kitchen at midnight.
You are my favorite adventure, my safest place, and the most beautiful story I've ever been part of.
Thank you for choosing me, again and again.
Here's to Season 4 — and every season after.
